title: Free family fun, then Fort Lauderdale after dark
igCaption:
Miami Beach Fire Department is hosting its 39th Annual Children’s Fire Safety Festival.
Hogwharf returns to The Wharf Fort Lauderdale from October 9 through 11.
Brightline is also running late-night trains after select Kaseya Center shows.
Which one are you doing this week?

Sources: Miami’s Community News, Boca Raton Magazine, Secret Miami

#SouthFlorida #MiamiBeach #FortLauderdale #ThingsToDo

scenes.text: Need plans this week? Start with family safety in Miami Beach, then end late by the river in Fort Lauderdale.
Miami Beach Fire Department is hosting its 39th Annual Children’s Fire Safety Festival.
scenes.caption: Miami Beach Fire Department is hosting its 39th Annual Children’s Fire Safety Festival.

scenes.text: Then Hogwharf returns to The Wharf Fort Lauderdale from October 9 through 11. The venue fills with floating candles, house flags, a Chamber of Secrets photo wall, and costumed characters.
scenes.caption: Then Hogwharf returns to The Wharf Fort Lauderdale from October 9 through 11. The venue fills with floating candles, house flags, a Chamber of Secrets photo wall, and costumed characters.

scenes.text: The bar is also doing four specialty cocktails tied to Gryffindor, Slytherin, Ravenclaw, and Hufflepuff. RSVP online and you get a complimentary house scarf at the door. If you go, open NEAR and see which house fans were there.

scenes.text: If you’re going to a downtown Miami show, Brightline is running late-night trains after select Kaseya Center concerts. The station sits less than a mile from the arena, about a 15-minute walk.
